assay_description: Noncompetitive inhibition of chymotrypsin-like activity of human 20S proteasome beta 5 subunit assessed as hydrolysis of succinyl-LLVY-AMC fluorogenic substrate Lineweaver-Burk plot analysis

Competitive inhibition of chymotrypsin-like activity of human constitutive 20s proteasome beta-5 subunit using Suc-LLVY-AMC as substrate assessed as inhibition constant for dissociation of enzyme-inhibitor complex incubated for 15 mins prior to substrate addition measured after 45 mins by fluorescence assay
